entries.title: Mark 16:1
segments: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the [mother] of James, and Salome, bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.

entries.title: Mark 16:2
segments: And very early on the first day of the week, they come to the tomb when the sun was risen.

entries.title: Mark 16:3
segments: And they were saying among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the tomb?

entries.title: Mark 16:4
segments: and looking up, they see that the stone is rolled back: for it was exceeding great.

entries.title: Mark 16:5
segments: And entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, arrayed in a white robe; and they were amazed.

entries.title: Mark 16:6
segments: And he saith unto them, Be not amazed: ye seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who hath been crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold, the place where they laid him!

entries.title: Mark 16:7
segments: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, He goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.

entries.title: Mark 16:8
segments: And they went out, and fled from the tomb; for trembling and astonishment had come upon them: and they said nothing to any one; for they were afraid.

entries.title: Mark 16:9
segments: Now when he was risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.

entries.title: Mark 16:10
segments: She went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

entries.title: Mark 16:11
segments: And they, when they heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, disbelieved.

entries.title: Mark 16:12
segments: And after these things he was manifested in another form unto two of them, as they walked, on their way into the country.

entries.title: Mark 16:13
segments: And they went away and told it unto the rest: neither believed they them.

entries.title: Mark 16:14
segments: And afterward he was manifested unto the eleven themselves as they sat at meat; and he upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them that had seen him after he was risen.

entries.title: Mark 16:15
segments: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to the whole creation.

entries.title: Mark 16:16
segments: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that disbelieveth shall be condemned.

entries.title: Mark 16:17
segments: And these signs shall accompany them that believe: in my name shall they cast out demons; they shall speak with new tongues;

entries.title: Mark 16:18
segments: they shall take up serpents, and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall in no wise hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.

entries.title: Mark 16:19
segments: So then the Lord Jesus, after he had spoken unto them, was received up into heaven, and sat down at the right hand of God.

entries.title: Mark 16:20
segments: And they went forth, and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.
